quickHelpTitle: Bitcoin can feel overwhelming at first
quickHelpDescription: Most people are interested in Bitcoin, but do not know where to begin safely.
painPoints: You are unsure which wallet to choose
You do not want to make an expensive mistake
You want practical help, not technical jargon
You want to understand Bitcoin before making any decisions
problemClosing: That is exactly why BitcoinStart Nordics exists.
solutionDescription: We offer simple, practical Bitcoin sessions designed for beginners. Our focus is to help you understand the basics, improve your confidence, and move forward in a safer and more structured way.

benefits.title: Clear explanations in plain language
benefits.text: We explain what matters without technical jargon or unnecessary complexity.

benefits.title: Practical step-by-step guidance
benefits.text: Each session is designed to help you move from confusion to a clearer next step.

benefits.title: Security-focused approach
benefits.text: We prioritize safer habits, clearer thinking, and fewer beginner mistakes.

benefits.title: Educational support without hype
benefits.text: We do not push decisions. We help you understand Bitcoin more clearly first.

bookingProcessDescription: Many people hesitate because the process feels unclear. Here's exactly how it works:

bookingSteps.title: Book your session
bookingSteps.description: Choose the Bitcoin session that fits your needs — whether you're completely new or ready for practical wallet setup.

bookingSteps.title: Choose a time that suits you
bookingSteps.description: Select from available time slots in our calendar that work best for your schedule.

bookingSteps.title: Receive confirmation by email
bookingSteps.description: We'll send you a confirmation with session details, login link, and any preparation materials you might need.

bookingSteps.title: Join your online session
bookingSteps.description: At the scheduled time, join us for your one-on-one Bitcoin education session with clear guidance and practical support.
